title: Paloma Business Payout Timing Card: Cut-Off, Delivery, Cancellation and Return Fees
content:
For each Paloma Business plan this card gives the latest US Central time on a business day for a payout to be released that day, the Paloma business days from release to the beneficiary's expected receipt, the fee for cancelling a payout before release, and the fee charged when a beneficiary bank returns a payout.

| | Paloma Business Starter | Paloma Business Essentials | Paloma Business Growth | Paloma Business Pro | Paloma Business Scale | Paloma Business Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Release cut-off (US Central time) | 14:00 | 14:00 | 15:00 | 15:00 | 16:00 | 16:00 |
| Delivery after release (Paloma business days) | 2 | 2 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Payout cancellation fee (USD, before release) | 5.00 | 5.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Return fee (USD, when a beneficiary bank returns a payout) | 15.00 | 15.00 | 12.00 | 10.00 | 8.00 | 5.00 |

### Reading the card

- Paloma Business Starter and Essentials share the earliest cut-off (14:00 CT), the longest delivery (2 Paloma business days) and the only cancellation fee above zero (5.00 USD).
- The return fee falls with the plan: 15.00 USD on Starter and Essentials down to 5.00 USD on Enterprise.

### Hypothetical illustration

A payout on Paloma Business Growth released at 14:45 CT on a Paloma business day is within that plan's 15:00 cut-off; with 1 Paloma business day of delivery, the beneficiary's expected receipt is the next Paloma business day.
